tier1.text: Each pubococcygeus helps form the levator ani, a muscle that supports the organs in the pelvis. The other muscle in the levator ani is the iliococcygeus. The pubococcygeus lies in the pelvic floor, the sheet of muscle at the bottom of the pelvis.
